newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: L&M, Austria's PCD in Malaysian venture.
newsitem.headline: L&M, Austria's PCD in Malaysian venture.

text.p: L&M Group Investments Ltd said on Tuesday a wholly owned unit and a Malaysian associate company had agreed to invest in a geotextile manufacturing and distribution company in Malaysia with PCD Polymere Gesellschaft m.b.h. (PCD) and Polyfelt Gesellschaft m.b.h. of Austria.

L&M said in a statement its two companies, L&M Geotechnic Pte Ltd and L&M Agencies Sdn Bhd of Malaysia, would each subscribe for a 19 percent interest in the joint venture. PCD would hold the remaining 62 percent.
The authorised and paid up share capital of the joint venture would be increased initially to 30 million Malaysian ringgit and 14.85 million ringgit respectively.

The L&M companies would later subscribe to more shares in the company and would eventually hold a total of 49 percent with PCD holding 51 percent. The three companies would additionally buy 52.94 million shares in the venture in the same proportions.
